genes.name: active_set_polish
genes.hypothesis: The log-sum-exp surrogate leaves a gap of about log(active shifts)/beta between its minimiser and a true minimax point. Solving the linearised minimax exactly over the near-maximal shifts (a linear program in a trust box, on grids of at most 2048 steps) equalises the plateau of f*f and closes that gap.
genes.predicted: -1e-3 to -1e-4 in score at n <= 2048 for budgets of a minute or more; nothing or a loss at short budgets, where the LPs eat the descent time
genes.author: seed

genes.name: edge_spike_init
genes.hypothesis: Extremisers of autocorrelation inequalities blow up like an inverse square root at both ends of the support (the published best step functions start and end with heights 50-70 times the mean). Starting from 1/sqrt(u(1-u)) instead of a flat function saves the coarse stage the work of building the spikes.
genes.predicted: small gain at short budgets, none at long ones
genes.author: seed

genes.name: multistart_coarse
genes.hypothesis: The landscape has many basins, and the basin is decided on the coarsest grid: 12 random starts at n = 128 ended between 1.465 and 1.490, while refinement to finer grids moves a basin by far less than that spread. Spending most of the coarse budget on many short descents and continuing only from the best one selects a better basin for the price of a shallower coarse descent.
genes.predicted: -0.002 to -0.006 in score at budgets of a minute or more; a loss at budgets too short for the starts to separate
genes.author: seed

genes.name: coarse_n
genes.hypothesis: Number of steps on the coarsest grid. Coarse grids are cheap and decide the basin; too coarse and the basin is the wrong one.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: coarse_fraction
genes.hypothesis: Share of the budget spent on the coarsest grid; the finer grids share the rest equally, the finest counting twice.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: init_noise
genes.hypothesis: Standard deviation of the Gaussian noise added to the flat starting function (mean 1). It is the only source of diversity between seeds.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: beta0
genes.hypothesis: Initial sharpness of the log-sum-exp surrogate, in units where the score is about 1.5. Low values see the whole of f*f, high values only its peaks.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: beta_growth
genes.hypothesis: Factor by which the sharpness grows after every L-BFGS stage (up to 3e6).
genes.author: seed

genes.name: stage_evals
genes.hypothesis: Surrogate evaluations per L-BFGS stage before the sharpness is raised.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: polish_fraction
genes.hypothesis: Share of each grid's budget given to the active-set polish instead of the surrogate descent.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: polish_window
genes.hypothesis: Shifts within this relative distance of the maximum enter the linear program (at most 1536 of them). Too narrow and the step runs into shifts it did not see; too wide and the LP is slow.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: polish_radius
genes.hypothesis: Initial half-width of the trust box of the polish, in units of the mean height; it adapts afterwards.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: multistart_count
genes.hypothesis: Number of starts on the coarsest grid. More starts sample more basins but each gets less time to show its level.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: multistart_fraction
genes.hypothesis: Share of the coarsest grid's budget spent on the starts; the rest deepens the winner before the first refinement.
genes.author: seed
